methodology.within_identifiers_table_lifts_note: All 34 within-identifiers "cross-references" are fccid.io-internal (equipment_class codes like DTS/PCB/JBP shared across vendors via same source sid=51). Per CP24, same-source re-extraction is not §8.3 corroboration.
methodology.lift_formula: §8.3 = min(99, max(originals) + 5); primary_registry single-source ceiling 85 per CP15
methodology.independence_rationale: fcc_grantees (sid=7 FCC.gov EAS open-data) is independent of fccid.io (sid=51 third-party scrape) per CP24 cross-source independence test (different collector, different methodology). CP21 strict-reading places sid=7 in primary_registry band (per line 805).
methodology.lift_NOT_auto_applied: §11 #8 cardinal rule — Validator proposes, CEO ratifies. Structural-anchor-as-§8.3-corroboration is a methodology question, not auto-promotable.
